enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Pull blanket over body. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Breathe slowly. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Remain still. Turn to back. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up and getting out of bed
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up in bed. Rub eyes. Swing legs to side of bed. Place feet on floor. Stand up. Stretch arms. Walk to bedroom door. Open door. Walk out of bedroom.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Hang towel. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, milk, bread. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Pour milk into glass. Put bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Pour eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Flip eggs. Turn off stove. Remove eggs from pan. Place on plate. Toast pops up. Take toast. Butter toast. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Stand up. Clear dishes. Rinse dishes. Place in sink. Turn off light. Walk out of kitchen.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Check schedule. Put on scrubs. Wash hands. Review patient charts. Enter patient room. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Update records. Attend meeting. Take lunch break. Eat lunch. Return to work. Assist with procedure. Sterilize equipment. Clean patient room. Talk to colleague. Write notes. Answer phone. Meet with doctor. Complete paperwork. Leave workplace.
Leave workplace. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter house.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables, chicken. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Wash vegetables. Cut vegetables. Heat pan. Add oil. Add chicken. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add sauce. Cover pan. Wait. Turn off stove. Serve on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Clear dishes. Rinse. Place in dishwasher. Turn off light. Walk out of kitchen.

Enter living room. Turn on TV. Pick up remote. Sit on couch. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Change channel again. Lean back. Put feet on coffee table. Watch TV. Stand up. Stretch. Sit down. Continue watching TV. Turn off TV. Stand up.

Sit at desk. Open laptop. Turn on computer. Log in. Open browser. Check email. Reply to email. Open social media. Scroll. Open document. Type. Save. Close browser. Shut down computer. Close laptop. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Adjust water temperature. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Lather. Rinse. Shampoo hair. Rinse. Turn off water. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around body. Brush teeth. Apply moisturizer. Put on pajamas. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing, reading, and winding down for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on light. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read. Turn page. Read. Turn page. Close book. Place book on nightstand. Turn off light. Lie down. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Breathe deeply. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up. Turn to back. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Remain still.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Pull blanket up. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Breathe slowly. Remain still. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping.
